releaseNotes: Fix: touch coordinates are now actually calibrated. Previously no calibration was ever applied (LovyanGFX defaults to an identity transform), so a resistive-touch board's raw ADC reading (roughly 128-3968) passed straight through instead of being scaled to the panel's real pixel dimensions -- every touch landed far outside the valid range and got clamped to the same corner regardless of where the screen was actually touched. Companion's Sidekick device settings now has a 'Calibrate Touch' button (resistive/XPT2046 models: 2.8", 3.5") that runs a one-time 4-corner tap calibration and saves it to the device's flash, so it only needs to be done once per physical unit.
